Aclaris Therapeutics to Participate in the 2026 Cantor Global Healthcare Conference


September 3, 2026


WAYNE, Pa., Sept. 03, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Aclaris Therapeutics, Inc. (NASDAQ: ACRS), a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company focused on developing novel product candidates for immuno-inflammatory diseases, today announced that on Thursday, September 10, 2026, at 2:45 PM ET, Aclaris’ Chief Executive Officer Dr. Neal Walker will participate in a fireside chat during the 2026 Cantor Global Healthcare Conference in New York, NY.


A live and archived webcast of this event will be accessible on the[Events page](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=RZYEShk33UL1d29_hJnoFNAhogv3FMwYueH8gob8YMktS_fez91zKiv5CwQhq8rmuM8wtMEt7lHoH_bMfVw5iLvyPc73SOK5ixrNmk3hOI8=) of the Aclaris website,[www.aclaristx.com](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=SH5vC243NYHiJkQdvG4Bzjd8fM0cMKryaX4BYxoFP9JqwyTXkzhWgkHjAUNRB-RugW4g157M8-RrD9UjqDU39bXvvL65-BofXjzqad-759A=) . The webcast will be available on the Aclaris website for at least 30 days.


**About Aclaris Therapeutics, Inc.**


Aclaris Therapeutics, Inc. is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company developing a pipeline of novel product candidates to address the needs of patients with immuno-inflammatory diseases who lack satisfactory treatment options. The company has a multi-stage portfolio of product candidates powered by a robust R&D engine. For additional information, please visit www.aclaristx.com and follow Aclaris on[LinkedIn](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=fEhgiJ4tdc38j7Egxtmh2QKpkcGXRJjgKINjMX52W4w8hrUy6TsZTvmHCcLVLaF8sXD1IHoY9NK5GLYvr-ztXMTwyyEytM1cXTw0T4sSvQJxu4i7fRIln6fZ3DjJQKhP) .
